work.name: Channel Core
highlights: Integrating 6 social platforms (Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, LinkedIn, Snapchat, X) via OAuth & building automatic token refresh and credential rotation with retry-backed sync recovery, keeping 500+ records synced daily

Building production infrastructure serving 150+ creators — architecting separate dev/prod environments on Neon with automated S3 backups and branch protection, eliminating risk of dev changes affecting live users

work.name: SUNY Research Foundation — CUBS Lab (Prof. Srirangaraj Setlur)
highlights: Engineered LLM-based extraction (strict JSON schemas) that chunks 90-140K character grant pages into 4 targeted tasks, recovering funding fields missed on 100% of pages by single-call extraction.
Built an async grant-aggregation pipeline (Python/asyncio) scraping NIH, grants.gov, and PCORI via 3 pluggable parsers, streaming through 10 concurrent workers with bounded back-pressure queues.

Ensured zero-data-loss reliability via failure-only persistence, a replayable retry mode, and 3-attempt exponential backoff across scrape/LLM/DB stages, upserting into an 8-table MySQL schema deduped by external ID.

work.name: Safety Knights
highlights: Architected and shipped a production EHS job board currently in beta with 4,000 users, spanning an Express/Node.js API (75+ endpoints, AES-256 encryption), an Angular v17 SSR consumer app, and a standalone admin console across 3 independently deployable codebases.
Built a full candidate pipeline with GridFS document storage, 5-stage status tracking, and 3 automated email flows, plus multi-axis job search and automated hourly listing expiration.

work.name: CarWale [CarTrade Tech]
highlights: Engineered and maintained the 'Oxygen Design System', a core library of 70+ reusable components in React and React Native that directly supported 80 million monthly users, achieving a 10% bundle-size reduction on critical pages via a new counter-based hashing system.
Cut a two-week estimate to 2 days (5x faster) by leveraging AI-driven automation and prompt engineering to update 250+ files.

projects.name: bro-cli
projects.description: Cross-shell CLI alias manager preserving shell state (cd, env activation) across invocations
highlights: Built single-binary Rust CLI (bash/zsh/fish/PowerShell/cmd) that emits shell code for the wrapper to eval, letting stored aliases mutate the live shell — cd, export, venv activation persist across runs.
